description: This file contains the code-behind for the 'TheorySet' web page in an online exam system. It handles UI interactions, database operations related to theory questions and course/exam management, and navigation between different admin pages.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Partial class for the code-behind of the TheorySet ASP.NET page, managing course selection, question addition, and exam setup functionalities.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event, currently empty but typically used for initialization.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new theory question to the database and updates question number.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Sets the exam details for the selected course, adding an entry to the database.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears input fields for questions and marks.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by transitioning to the login page.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course dropdown items based on selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Calculates and displays the next question number for the selected course.
